mob.demo_note: A made-up streamer, to see the app without the device
mob.busy: The streamer already serves three clients. Trying again…
mob.not_panel: There is no ModESP streamer at this address
mob.no_panel_note: The phone and the streamer need to be on the same Wi-Fi
mob.wifi_join_note_ap: The streamer will turn off its access point and the app will lose the connection to it. Join “{name}” with this phone — the app will find the streamer there. If it fails, the access point comes back.
mob.wifi_join_note: The streamer will leave its current network for a few seconds. If “{name}” does not answer, it comes back and this shows why. If “{name}” is a different network, join it with the phone too.
mob.wifi_forget_body: The streamer will leave the network and turn on its own access point. The app will lose the connection to it.
mob.wifi_forget_back: To come back, join “{name}” with the phone and add the streamer at {ip}.
mob.fw_restarting: Installed. The streamer is restarting — {n} s
mob.fw_not_image: This is not a firmware image
